risk: Everything-product never reaches useful release
mitigation: Slice releases; one shell over existing adapters first; research off critical path

risk: Idle demo collapses under real background load
mitigation: Mixed-load gates from first transport; reserve RT resources

risk: Atomic routing overhead exceeds benefit
mitigation: Explicit TaskSpec baseline; fusion; graduate bounded cases only

risk: Remote memory/VRAM presented as uniform and causes pathological latency/coherence
mitigation: Explicit locality/consistency/cost in every object descriptor

risk: Stuck keys/buttons or dual focus damages user state
mitigation: Pressed-state ledger, prepare/commit, fencing, break-glass input

risk: Ableton recording/monitoring xruns under contention
mitigation: RT admission, isolation, local authoritative path, mixed-load soak

risk: High average FPS hides bad frame-age tail
mitigation: Frame age/p99/bursts and hardware visible latency, not average FPS

risk: HDR/color transforms silently clip or mis-map
mitigation: Explicit intent/capability/transform graph and reference patterns

risk: macOS permissions/secure input block seamless behavior
mitigation: Use supported APIs, explicit consent, feature fallback

risk: Windows driver/helper signing and maintenance becomes dominant
mitigation: Minimize privileged code, defer true VHF/virtual display where existing adapters suffice

risk: IOMMU/PCIe/P2P topology differs from assumptions
mitigation: Probe and benchmark exact topology; no name-based capability claims

risk: WAN jitter/loss creates unsafe input/audio state
mitigation: Independent queues, fencing, adaptation, local RT independence

risk: Global input/capture service becomes keylogger/surveillance vector
mitigation: Narrow privileged helper, capabilities, local indicators, audit, red team

risk: Pairing/relay compromise grants remote control
mitigation: ECDH-confirmed enrollment, mTLS, revocation, no plain-secret bootstrap

risk: Malicious endpoint advertises false capabilities/cost
mitigation: Signed descriptors plus active probes and policy bounds

risk: Clipboard/file route exfiltrates secrets
mitigation: Typed sensitivity/provenance, WAN prompt/deny, limits and redaction

risk: OOB KVM exposed to public network
mitigation: Management VLAN/overlay ACL, no port-forward default, separate credentials

risk: Object authority split or stale replica returned
mitigation: Version/epoch authority, immutable replication, fail closed for mutable writes

risk: Object plane duplicates filesystem/database badly
mitigation: Limit to runtime objects; bridge conventional authoritative stores

risk: Prediction causes migration/cache thrash
mitigation: Hysteresis, cooldown, min residency, uncertainty margin, regret telemetry

risk: Resource model misses memory/PCIe/encoder externality
mitigation: Probe and pressure telemetry; counterfactual mixed-load benchmark

risk: Moving background work slows it without protecting foreground
mitigation: Measure both SLO benefit and displaced completion cost

risk: Owned windows/popups/IME/DPI fail for arbitrary apps
mitigation: Semantic route first; per-app compatibility and full-desktop fallback

risk: Protected/DRM/UAC surface appears blank at critical time
mitigation: Detect/fail explicitly and offer console/OOB/local confirmation

risk: Encoder-session exhaustion with many app proxies
mitigation: Atlas, dedicated-stream selection, session admission and fallback

risk: Cross-device clock drift causes audio glitches or bad timestamps
mitigation: Clock domains, drift estimator, ASRC, uncertainty bounds, soak

risk: Upgrade mismatches core/helper/adapter and strands control
mitigation: Compatibility manifest, canary, transactional upgrade and rollback

risk: Coordinator loss leaves routes in split-brain state
mitigation: Fenced lease epoch, data-plane lease expiry and warm replica

risk: Recovery depends on same failed software stack
mitigation: Independent OOB and local emergency route

risk: Expert graph overwhelms ordinary workflow
mitigation: Simple workspace mode; patchbay optional; scenario usability tests

risk: One shell hides important quality/security changes
mitigation: Route explanation and explicit profile/fallback indicators

risk: Fabric duplicates thegent/NVMS/ShareCLI authority
mitigation: Boundary ADRs, shared contracts, repo consolidation decision

risk: Universal DB/ontology creates coupling and contested truth
mitigation: Independent stores/authority and event/API reconciliation

risk: Parsec/Apple/Microsoft/NVIDIA API or licensing changes
mitigation: Adapter isolation, open alternatives, support matrix and exit plan

risk: License combinations prevent packaged distribution
mitigation: SBOM/license gate, process-boundary adapters, legal review before release

risk: Input/capture/VM mechanisms conflict with games/content
mitigation: Per-title/app compatibility; do not bypass protections; local/full console fallback

risk: Benchmark cherry-picking overstates novelty
mitigation: Predeclared hypotheses, failed runs, counterfactuals and raw data

risk: Reference devices insufficient for general claims
mitigation: Fingerprint-scoped support and broadened preview matrix over time

risk: Sustained media+compute throttles laptops/GPUs
mitigation: Thermal/power as resource dimensions; profile adaptation

risk: Evidence bundles capture titles, audio, clipboard or files
mitigation: Content-off default, redaction, explicit test consent and retention

risk: External adapter project is archived/abandoned
mitigation: Version pin, minimal fork policy, replaceable adapter contract

risk: No clear adoption wedge outside full ecosystem
mitigation: Ship standalone seat/workspace/VM/Mac sink utility first
